title: A geometric realization of socle-projective categories for posets of type $\mathbb{D}$
summary: We introduce posets of type $\mathbb{D}$, a family of posets described by an admissible Dynkin quiver of type $D_n$ together with a compatible set of extra arrows (alien arrows), and show that their socle-projective representation category is of finite representation type. Continuing, in the same spirit, a program initiated for posets of type $\mathbb{A}$ [R. Schiffler, R-J. Serna, A geometric realization of socle-projective categories for posets of type $\mathbb{A}$, J. Pure Appl.
